SRC-265:R001.text: Authenticate the actual operator command behind E-3221, including carrier, scope and precedence.

SRC-265:R002.text: Determine whether that authority permits bounded software security remediation independently from T-261 hardware acceptance.

SRC-265:R003.text: Verify whether later operator directives supersede or restrict the recorded authorization.

SRC-265:R005.text: Do not silently remove needs: T-261.

SRC-265:R006.text: If existing authority permits remediation, establish the correct canonical admission and ownership using supported SAIPEN operations.

SRC-265:R007.text: Keep hardware acceptance and publication blocked.

SRC-265:R008.text: Preserve the existing corrected source and test evidence without fabricating historical execution.

SRC-265:R009.text: If valid authority is absent, produce exactly one precise operator decision request.

SRC-265:R010.text: Do not make the operator manually edit BOARD, STATE, LOG or rerun ordinary diagnostic commands.
